articles.headline: Beijing Officials Hold Closed-Door Talks in Hong Kong Ahead of Leadership Transition
articles.summary_html:
Senior mainland officials have reportedly been shuttling through Hong Kong this month on what insiders describe as a wide-ranging fact-finding missionan organised visit intended to gather first-hand information before an important decision is made實地考察, according to a report by The Standard. The visiting delegation is said to have held a series of closed-door meetingsprivate discussions held away from public view or media attention閉門會議 with figures from the business and political sectors, sounding outasking people informally for their views in order to gauge likely reaction試探意見 potential candidates’ willingness to serve in the city’s next government while also gauging the health of the local economy.

Political analyst Lau Siu-kai told the paper that such visits are standard practicean accepted, routine way of doing something that is expected rather than unusual慣常做法, noting that the central government regularly consults through various channelsa range of different routes or means by which information or opinion is gathered不同途徑 before settling on the make-up of the next Hong Kong cabinet. The timing is significant: a small-circle election is being organised to renew the 1,500-member Election Committee, the Beijing-loyalist body that in turn selects the chief executive, fuelling speculation over whether incumbent John Lee will be given a second term.

Beijing has also signalled, through the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office, what it expects from the incoming team, calling for officials chosen on the basis of integrity and competencehonesty and moral soundness combined with the skill needed to do a job well廉潔與才能 and urging the city to overhaul how it trains, selects and manages governance talentcapable individuals suited to holding public office and running a government治理人才. Commentators say the consultations illustrate how firmly the choice of the next chief executive and cabinet remains a Beijing-led processa process whose outcome is ultimately decided and directed by the central government由北京主導的程序, even as local business and political figures are given a chance to voice their views.
articles.summary_zh_html:
據《英文虎報》（The Standard）報道，多名內地高層官員本月據報一直在香港穿梭，進行一次消息人士形容為範圍廣泛的實地考察。消息指，到訪的代表團與商界及政界人士舉行了一連串閉門會議，一方面試探意見，了解有意人士是否願意加入下屆政府，另一方面亦藉機了解本港經濟狀況。

政治評論員劉兆佳向該報表示，這類到訪屬慣常做法，並指中央政府在敲定下屆香港班子人選前，一直會透過不同途徑進行諮詢。而今次的時機別具意義：香港正籌組選舉，以改選由1500名委員組成的選舉委員會——這個親北京陣營主導的機構將負責選出下任行政長官，令外界猜測現任特首李家超能否獲得連任。

北京亦已透過國務院港澳事務辦公室表明對新一屆管治班子的期望，要求挑選具備廉潔與才能的官員，並促請本港全面檢討培訓、選拔及管理治理人才的方式。評論人士指出，今次連串諮詢顯示，下任行政長官及班子人選始終是一項由北京主導的程序，即使本地商界及政界人士獲邀表達意見，亦難以改變這一格局。

No text, signs or logos.

articles.headline: Hong Kong's Symphony of Lights to Take Its Final Bow After Two Decades
articles.summary_html:
After more than two decades lighting up Victoria Harbour, A Symphony of LightsHong Kong’s long-running nightly laser and multimedia show over Victoria Harbour幻彩詠香江 will give its last-ever performance on 18 November, The Standard has learned. First launched in January 2004 and later recognised by Guinness World Records as the world’s largest permanent light and sound show, the display has become one of the harbour’s most recognisable tourist drawsan attraction that is especially effective at bringing visitors to a place吸引遊客的賣點, projecting synchronised lights and music from dozens of buildings on both sides of the harbour every night.

Officials say the decision to retire the show was driven mainly by its mounting running coststhe ever-increasing expense of keeping something operating不斷上升的營運成本 and by a steady decline in appeal among repeat visitors, even after a 2017 revamp added a new musical score performed by the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra. The farewell performance, set for 8pm, will include a special pyrotechnic displayan elaborate fireworks show put on for a special occasion特別煙火表演 as a send-off, and will coincide with the opening night of this year’s WinterFest, described by organisers as the largest-ever editionthe biggest version of a regular event that has ever been held歷來規模最大的一屆 of the festival.

Rather than returning to a single, fixed nightly show, the Tourism Board plans to replace Symphony of Lights with a more flexible rotation of seasonal light programmes spread acrossdistributed over an area rather than concentrated in just one spot分佈於 multiple districts, including Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said the new format need not be confined to Victoria Harbour, framing the change as part of a wider push to encourage visitors to venture beyond the harbourfronttravel to areas further away than the main, well-known waterfront area走出海旁範圍 into neighbourhoods across the city. The move has stirred mixed feelings among residents who grew up with the nightly display as a fixture of harbour life, even as tourism officials insist that reinventing the attractioncompletely changing something to give it a fresh form or purpose為景點注入新意 is necessary to sustain visitor interest in the long run.
articles.summary_zh_html:
在維多利亞港上空閃耀逾二十年後，《幻彩詠香江》據《英文虎報》報道，將於11月18日舉行最後一場演出。這項燈光音樂匯演於2004年1月首次登場，後來獲健力士世界紀錄認證為全球規模最大的常設燈光音效表演，多年來一直是維港夜景最具代表性的吸引遊客的賣點之一，每晚利用維港兩岸數十座大樓同步投射燈光，並配合音樂演出。

官員表示，決定讓這項表演退役，主要是因為其不斷上升的營運成本，以及重遊旅客的興趣持續下降——即使在2017年完成革新，加入由香港管弦樂團演奏的全新配樂後，情況依然如此。告別演出將於晚上八時舉行，並會加插一場特別煙火表演作為謝幕，而演出當晚亦正值今年冬日祭開幕——主辦方形容今年為該節目歷來規模最大的一屆。

旅遊發展局計劃不再單靠一個固定的每晚表演，而是改以更靈活的季節性燈光節目，分佈於多個地區舉行，包括尖沙咀及銅鑼灣。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，新形式不必局限於維港一帶，並形容此舉是推動旅客走出海旁範圍，深入全港各區的更廣泛策略之一。這項轉變，令不少自小伴隨這場每晚匯演成長的市民感到五味雜陳，但旅遊官員則堅持，為景點注入新意是維持長遠旅客興趣的必要之舉。

articles.headline: Kai Tak Sports Park Tops 2.8 Million Visitors, Gears Up to Host BTS and Bruno Mars
articles.summary_html:
Kai Tak Sports Park has welcomed more than 2.8 million spectators to its Main Stadium in the 18 months since opening, the venue operator said this week, as the former airport site cements its role as Hong Kong’s new mega-event huba large, purpose-built venue capable of hosting very large-scale events大型活動樞紐. Since opening in March 2025, the park has staged more than 190 international and local eventsevents that include both overseas productions and ones organised within Hong Kong國際及本地活動, ranging from football friendlies and track meets to large-scale concerts.

The venue’s concert calendar is only getting busier. This week alone, K-pop veterans BIGBANG are playing a sold-out three-night run at the Main Stadium to mark the group’s 20th anniversary, and organisers have confirmed further headlining performancesconcerts in which a single famous act is the main, most important attraction主打表演 by BTS, Charlie Puth and Bruno Mars in the months ahead. The steady stream of A-list bookingsengagements by the most famous and sought-after performers in the entertainment industry一線藝人演出 has helped the 50,000-seat stadium establish itself among Asia’s leading concert destinations within a remarkably short time.

Tourism officials have credited the park with driving footfallcausing a noticeable increase in the number of people visiting a place帶動人流 to the wider Kai Tak district, with nearby hotels and the adjoining shopping mall reporting a knock-on boost in business on concert weekends. Transport officials are meanwhile moving to ease congestionovercrowding that slows or blocks the normal flow of people or traffic擁堵 around the Tuen Ma line’s Kai Tak station, with extra train frequencies planned to help the venue cope with crowds of tens of thousands arriving for a single show. Analysts say the park’s early success illustrates how a single well-designed mega-event venuea site built specifically to attract and host very large events大型活動場館 can reshape a neighbourhood’s economy, though some residents living nearby have also raised concerns about noise disturbancean unwanted and disruptive level of sound affecting those living or working nearby噪音困擾 on concert nights.
articles.summary_zh_html:
啟德體育園主場館自開幕以來18個月內，已接待超過280萬名觀眾入場，場館營運方本周表示，這座前機場舊址正逐步確立其作為香港新大型活動樞紐的地位。體育園自2025年3月開幕以來，已舉辦超過190項國際及本地活動，項目涵蓋足球友賽、田徑賽事以至大型演唱會。

場館的演唱會檔期只會愈趨繁忙。單是本周，韓國組合BIGBANG已於主場館一連三晚舉行門票售罄的二十周年紀念演出，而主辦方亦已確認未來數月將迎來防彈少年團（BTS）、Charlie Puth及Bruno Mars等主打表演。接連不斷的一線藝人演出，令這座可容納五萬人的主場館在短時間內，已躍身成為亞洲區內數一數二的演唱會勝地。

旅遊官員表示，體育園有助帶動人流進入啟德一帶，附近酒店及毗鄰商場亦報稱於演唱會周末生意有所提升。與此同時，運輸部門正著手緩解屯馬線啟德站周邊的擁堵情況，計劃加密班次，以應付單場演出動輒數萬人湧至的人流壓力。分析人士指出，體育園的初步成功，正好說明一座設計得宜的大型活動場館如何能夠重塑一個社區的經濟面貌，不過亦有附近居民對演唱會舉行期間的噪音困擾表達關注。

articles.headline: Northern Link Rail Cost Cut by 28% to HK$86.2 Billion, Full Line Still on Track for 2034
articles.summary_html:
The government and MTR Corporation have signed off on the second phase of the Northern Link railway, with the combined cost of the Main Line and Spur Line now pegged at HK$86.2 billiona sum of money stated at July 2025 prices862億港元 — 28 percent below the original estimate. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan and MTR chief executive Jacob Kam signed the comprehensive project agreementa formal, all-encompassing contract covering every stage of a major infrastructure project全面項目協議 after the Chief Executive in Council approved the financial arrangements, clearing the way for construction on the strategic railway projectan infrastructure project seen as crucial to a region’s long-term development plans具戰略意義的鐵路項目 to proceed at pace.

Phase two alone, covering tunnels, stations, a depot and electrical and mechanical systems, is estimated at HK$54.8 billion, with spending spread outdistributed gradually over a period of time instead of paid all at once分攤 over roughly a decade, starting with HK$1.1 billion in 2027. Officials say the savings were achieved partly through design refinements and partly through the rail-plus-property modela funding method that pairs railway construction with nearby property development so sale proceeds help cover costs鐵路加物業模式, under which the government has granted MTR eight sites for residential and commercial development, easing the need for direct government fundingmoney paid straight out of public coffers rather than raised through another mechanism政府直接注資.

The full line remains on track to open by 2034, connecting the western part of the Northern Metropolis to the existing rail network and significantly cutting journey times for residents of new towns planned for the border region. Transport officials say the project is central to unlocking land supplymaking otherwise inaccessible or underused land available for development by providing transport access釋放土地供應 in the Northern Metropolis, Hong Kong’s flagship development zone intended to ease the housing shortage and create space for new industries. Critics, however, have questioned whether cost overrunsspending that ends up higher than originally planned or budgeted超支 seen on other mega-projects might still resurface as construction gets under way, and whether demand for homes in the new towns will materialise as quickly as planners hope.
articles.summary_zh_html:
政府與港鐵公司已就北環線第二階段工程拍板，主線連同支線的合併造價現定為862億港元（以2025年7月價格計算），較原先估算低28%。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶與港鐵行政總裁甘俊樂，在行政長官會同行政會議批准相關財務安排後，簽署全面項目協議，為這項具戰略意義的鐵路項目的建造工程全速展開鋪平道路。

第二階段工程涵蓋隧道、車站、車廠以及機電系統，估計造價為548億港元，有關開支將分攤約十年支付，首筆款項為2027年的11億港元。官員表示，造價得以下調，部分原因是設計上作出優化，部分則歸功於鐵路加物業模式——政府已批出八個地盤供港鐵發展住宅及商業項目，藉此減少對政府直接注資的需要。

全線預計仍可按計劃於2034年通車，屆時將連接北部都會區西部與現有鐵路網絡，大幅縮短邊境新市鎮居民的出行時間。運輸官員表示，此項目對於釋放土地供應至關重要——北部都會區是香港的旗艦發展計劃，旨在緩解房屋短缺問題，並為新興產業創造空間。不過，有批評者質疑，其他大型基建項目曾出現的超支問題，會否在工程展開後重現，以及新市鎮的住屋需求能否如規劃般迅速湧現。
articles.image_scene: A daytime construction site in Hong Kong's New Territories countryside, anonymous workers in hard hats and high-visibility vests operating excavators beside a half-built railway viaduct, construction cranes in the background, distant low-rise villages and green hills beyond the site fencing. No text, signs or logos.

trends.headline: 📱👶 Viral Threads Post Names Hong Kong Parents' Top 'Parenting Fails'
trends.summary_html:
A Threads post cataloguing the "parenting fails"mistakes or poor decisions made by parents in raising their children, as judged with hindsight育兒失敗行為 of the past ten to twenty years has struck a nerve across Hong Kong, racking up thousands of shares after parenting outlet Oh!爭媽 condensed it into a tidy list of 20 items. Commenters quickly converged on a single worst offence: handing children an "electronic pacifier"a smartphone or tablet given to a young child simply to keep them calm and quiet電子奶嘴 of short, highly stimulating videos, only to complain later that the same children have grown restless and unable to concentrate. The original poster argued this habit may interfere with the healthy development of a child’s attention spanthe length of time a person is able to keep their mind focused on one task專注力, citing popular science claims about brain regions tied to memory and self-control.

Two other complaints rounded out the "top three parenting crimes"a list, half-jokingly framed as offences, of the most widely criticised mistakes parents make三大育兒罪狀: parents who avoid disciplining their children altogether for fear of repeating their own strict upbringing, and parents who claim to be open-mindedwilling to consider new or different ideas rather than rigid, old-fashioned ones開明 yet still quietly tie their child’s self-wortha person’s sense of their own value as an individual自我價值 to exam results. The viral list has triggered a wave of soul-searchingserious and honest reflection on one’s own behaviour, especially when it may be at fault自我反思 among Hong Kong parents, many of whom admitted online that they recognised themselves in at least one of the twenty items.
trends.summary_zh_html:
一篇在Threads上盤點港人過去十至二十年「育兒失敗行為」的帖文，近日引起全城共鳴，獲得親子平台《Oh!爸媽》整理成20項清單後，轉發量急增。網民迅速歸納出「頭號罪狀」：以播放高刺激短片的電子奶嘴餵大孩子，事後卻投訴孩子變得坐不定、難以集中。原帖樓主認為，這種習慣可能妨礙孩子專注力的健康發展，並引用流行的腦科學說法，指相關行為涉及與記憶及自我控制有關的腦區。

另外兩項指控則構成餘下的三大育兒罪狀：一是家長因害怕重演自己童年時的嚴厲管教，而完全不敢管教子女；二是表面開明，實際上卻仍暗中將孩子的自我價值與考試成績掛鈎。這份爆紅清單引發不少香港家長自我反思，當中不少人在網上坦言，在二十項指控之中至少認得自己一項。

causes.label: A generational reckoning with 1990s-style strict parenting
causes.label_zh: 與上一代嚴厲管教方式的世代清算
causes.text: Many of the twenty items are direct reactions against the harsh, authoritarian parenting many of today's parents experienced as children themselves, suggesting the list reflects a broader generational effort to consciously break cycles of strict discipline rather than simply criticising individual bad habits.
causes.text_zh: 清單中不少項目，其實是對現時家長自己童年時所經歷嚴厲、高壓管教方式的直接反彈，顯示這份清單所反映的，與其說是單純批評個別壞習慣，更像是一整代父母有意識地打破嚴厲管教循環的集體努力。

causes.label: Screen-based 'e-pacifiers' and shrinking attention spans
causes.label_zh: 螢幕「電子奶嘴」與日漸縮短的專注力
causes.text: Child-development experts have long warned that handing very young children smartphones loaded with fast-cut, highly stimulating videos may overstimulate developing brains, making slower, more effortful tasks like reading or schoolwork feel comparatively boring and undermining the patience parents later expect their children to show.
causes.text_zh: 兒童發展專家一直警告，過早讓幼童接觸節奏急促、高度刺激的手機短片，可能令仍在發展中的腦部受到過度刺激，令閱讀或做功課等需要耐性、較「慢」的活動相對顯得乏味，削弱家長日後期望子女具備的耐性。

causes.label: Tying grades to self-worth undermines genuine learning motivation
causes.label_zh: 將成績與自我價值掛鈎削弱真正的學習動機
causes.text: When children learn that their worth as a person rises and falls with test scores, even well-meaning encouragement can curdle into anxiety, pushing some students toward rote memorisation and exam tactics rather than genuine curiosity, a pattern teachers say is already visible well before students reach senior secondary school.
causes.text_zh: 當孩子從小感受到自身價值隨著考試分數高低而起伏，再善意的鼓勵亦可能演變成焦慮，令部分學生傾向死記硬背及應試技巧，而非出於真正的求知慾——老師指出，這種現象在學生升上高中前已相當明顯。

causes.label: A crowd-sourced list that oversimplifies complex parenting choices
causes.label_zh: 一張將複雜育兒抉擇過度簡化的網民清單
causes.text: Sceptics point out that a list crowdsourced from anonymous Threads comments is not a scientific study, and that real parenting decisions are shaped by financial pressure, long working hours and limited childcare support — context a tidy twenty-item checklist glosses over while making it easy for strangers to judge parents they know nothing about.
causes.text_zh: 質疑者指出，一張由Threads匿名留言拼湊而成的清單，終究不是科學研究，而真正的育兒抉擇往往受財政壓力、工時過長及託兒支援不足等現實因素影響——這些因素都被這份簡潔的二十項清單一概忽略，卻令陌生網民輕易地評判他們根本毫不了解的家長。
